name: Coven Rites (Coven)
body:
Through long practice and experienced leadership, your coven is more effective during occult rituals.

Prerequisite(s): Charisma 13, knowledge (arcana) 3 ranks, coven member.

Benefit(s): As long as all casters in an occult ritual are members of your coven, the secondary casters may apply your Charisma bonus as a morale bonus to skill checks.
